entry.name: jit.expr
entry.digest: Evaluate an expression to fill a matrix
entry.description: Evaluates expressions to fill an output matrix. The expression can contain any operator available from within jit.op, any functor available from within jit.bfg, and many jitter MOPs. A variable number of inputs can be specified with an attribute argument setting the inputs attribute.
